# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-styled task list built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No packages, network requests, or external assets.

## Features

- Add tasks via button or Enter key (input is trimmed; blank entries ignored)
- Total task count in `#todo-total` and incomplete count in `#remaining`
- Each task gets a checkbox, text span, and delete button with increasing numeric IDs
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count
- Deleting a task removes it and updates both counts
- All state kept in memory — no storage

## Files

- `index.html` — structure and required IDs
- `styles.css` — pixel-style theme, responsive to 360px
- `app.js` — task logic and rendering

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Works fully offline.

## Keyboard

- Tab to move between controls
- Enter in the input adds a task
- Space toggles a focused checkbox
- Enter/Space activates focused buttons
